coder_notes: Human ADME/mass-balance study of [14C]-AZD1390 in advanced solid malignancies. Glioblastoma appears only in keywords and detailed description (development rationale), not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, so per D27B/C7 coded not_glioblastoma rather than basket_gbm_eligible. AZD1390 listed as experimental_monotherapy though the study has no antitumour objective (single-dose ADME). 14C label is for mass balance, so radiopharmaceutical false. PK is plasma/whole blood/excreta only.
